# Genairosity

A software-freedom initiative from 508.dev. AI assistance is optional; any model
work is initiated locally by a human. Start with AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.

- DECISIONS.md: confirmed project scope and authority
- projects.json: registered projects and status
- candidates.json: initial investigation links (status remains in issues)
- docs/governance.md: lifecycle and maintainer decisions
- docs/clean-room.md: evidence, specification, and implementation boundaries
- docs/project-setup.md: initializer, publication, and registration checklist
- docs/overseer.md: locally invoked coordinator workflow
- docs/development.md: checks and preview
- docs/deployment.md: GitHub Pages publication
- devkit/README.md: portable project baseline
